site.title: Victory Arms Company LLC | SBA-Certified SDVOSB | Ammunition, Tactical Equipment, Marksmanship Training
site.description: Victory Arms Company LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business in Jacksonville, NC. Ammunition and tactical equipment supply, firearms and marksmanship training, and federal supply through DLA DIBBS. UEI ZZQAKXV8EJ41, CAGE 02S54.

entity.sourcing: Domestic and allied sourcing only. No hardware, optics, electronics or software from China, Russia, Iran or North Korea.

copy.headline: Small-Arms Ammunition, Tactical Equipment & Marksmanship Training
copy.subhead: SBA-certified SDVOSB quoting DLA and agency requirements through DIBBS and SAM.gov. Located in Jacksonville, NC, outside MCB Camp Lejeune.
copy.overview: Victory Arms Company LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business in Jacksonville, North Carolina, outside MCB Camp Lejeune. VAC supplies small-arms ammunition and tactical equipment by resale and distribution, delivers firearms and marksmanship training to government, law-enforcement and unit customers, and quotes federal supply requirements through DLA DIBBS.

competencies.title: Ammunition Supply & Distribution
bullets: NSN-level sourcing of small-arms ammunition (PSC 1305), supplied by resale and distribution
Training ammunition, targets and range consumables
Manufacturer and distributor quotes turned around against RFQ close dates

competencies.title: Firearms & Marksmanship Training
bullets: Rifle, pistol and shotgun marksmanship for government, law-enforcement and unit customers, fundamentals through qualification tables
Range operations: range safety officer staffing, range safety briefs, cold-range procedures
Programs built to the customer's qualification standard, delivered at the customer's range or a contracted commercial range

competencies.title: Tactical Equipment & Federal Supply
bullets: Weapon carry cases, drag bags, cleaning kits and maintenance items
DLA Land and Maritime and DLA Troop Support quoting through DIBBS (CAGE 02S54)
Commercial items quoted to SDVOSB set-asides and full-and-open RFQs

differentiators.title: Set-Aside Eligible
differentiators.text: SBA-certified SDVOSB and VOSB. Eligible for SDVOSB, VOSB and small-business set-asides.

differentiators.title: Ready to Quote
differentiators.text: Active in SAM.gov under CAGE 02S54. Electronic quotes on DLA automated RFQs.

differentiators.title: Local to Camp Lejeune
differentiators.text: Jacksonville, NC. On-site coordination with MCB Camp Lejeune and MCAS New River units and contracting offices.

differentiators.title: Principal-Direct
differentiators.text: Every quote priced and signed by the owner. One point of contact from RFQ to delivery.

copy.direction: Company direction: building toward domestic, automated production capacity for critical defense needs.
